scope: Selected source-backed listings and catalog observations; incomplete national coverage; no live inventory.
import_rules: Upsert by stable source-specific ID; merge cm_052 with the existing Cimencam lead, do not duplicate it.
Keep price observations separate from branch records. Branches do not require a numeric price to be discoverable.
Directory-listed is not merchant-confirmed, open-now, delivery-eligible or in-stock.
Never copy a city reference point to a store coordinate.
Do not transfer one seller price or one product stock claim to another branch or vendor.
Some manufacturers require trade/wholesale accounts. Show them separately from local shops.
Never fill missing price, reviews, stock, coordinates or delivery costs with a plausible value.
